description: cart-total is computed by summing unitPrice/100 × quantity in floating-point yuan and flooring back to cents. The initial total (96694 分) survives, but after incrementing the mouse row the float sum is 996.8399999… which floors to 99683 → ¥996.83 instead of ¥996.84, so the critical increment-updates-total test never sees the expected total. remove / decrement / cap paths happen to land on exact floats and still pass.
